name: Financial Assistance for Higher Studies
benefit:
- Financial assistance for students belonging to the Tea Tribes and Adivasi community.
- This assistance supports students pursuing higher studies such as Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS), Master of Business Administration (MBA), Engineering, and such other technical/higher education.
- The assistance covers higher studies in Administration, Medical, Engineering, Law, Research, and
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a permanent resident of Assam. - The applicant must belong to the Tea Tribes and Adivasi community. - The applicant must be pursuing higher studies such as Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS), Master of Business Administration (MBA), Engineering, and such other technical/higher education. - The applicant's family income must not exceed ₹5,00,000/- per annum. - The applicant should not be a Government Service holder. - Students studying through correspondence course are also eligible to apply.
